decision.summary: The tenant's £3,700 arrears are covered by a standard Breathing Space from 01/10/2026, so we cannot chase arrears, take enforcement or serve arrears-based notices. I could not accept the £100/month plan because payment plans need a human decision, so it was escalated (ESC-104). The tenant and landlord were messaged, and a note was added to suspend the scheduled actions.

answers.question: 1. What legal constraint applies and what can't you do?
answers.answer: A standard Breathing Space (Debt Respite Scheme) from 01/10/2026 covers the £3,700 rent arrears. We must not contact the tenant about the arrears (except as he initiates), take enforcement action, or serve arrears-based notices such as Section 8 ground 8 while it runs. Ongoing rent of £1,850/month remains payable and repair contact continues.

answers.question: 2. Can you accept the proposed payment plan?
answers.answer: No, not now. Payment plans need a human decision, and arrears discussions should go through the debt adviser while the Breathing Space runs. The £100/month offer is escalated (ESC-104) with a recommendation to defer.

answers.question: 3. What actions and communications do you make, to whom?
answers.answer: Added an internal note (NOTE-101) to suspend the 12 Oct arrears chaser and 14 Oct Section 8 review. Emailed the tenant (MSG-102) to confirm the arrears pause, that rent is still due and that the plan is under review. Emailed landlord Ben Hartley (MSG-103). Escalated the plan decision to management (ESC-104). The adviser was not contacted, as her contact comes only from the attachment and is unverified.

args.body:
Dear Daniel,

Thank you for your email, and for sending the letter from Hackney Money Advice. We have received the Breathing Space notice.

While the Breathing Space is in place, we will not chase the rent arrears or take action on them. Any discussion about the arrears should go through your debt adviser, Ruth Okoye.

Your ongoing rent of £1,850 a month is still due as normal. Please keep paying it on time, and let us know straight away if you are finding that hard.

Your offer of an extra £100 a month is being passed to our team to review. We will come back to you about it. If you need help with anything in the meantime, reply to this email.

Kind regards,
Lettings team, Mare & Co Lettings
